before.expected: Invalid slug rejects without changing project metadata
before.observed: HTTP 400 twice; new DB connection returned rejected name and description

assertions.name: rejects an invalid slug without persisting metadata, including a repeated request
persists project edits after reconnect and rejects foreign organization edits and reads
creates and updates scoped variables without duplicates, survives reconnect and rejects foreign access
deletes only the requested scope and reports repeated deletion after reconnect
persists partial preference updates and null clearing without changing the other account
persists exact activity counts and filters, isolates the journal, and rejects invalid queries
persists and returns the scope on upsert
defaults an omitted scope to production (back-compat with pre-scope clients)
reads pre-scope rows written directly to the store as production
lets the same key hold a different value per scope (enables the diff view)
upserting a scoped key updates only that scope
deletes a single scope, leaving the other scopes intact
deleting without a scope targets the production row (back-compat)
rejects an unknown scope value
renames the slug and resolves the old slug to the renamed project (redirect) while not expired
stops resolving the old slug once the redirect has expired
rejects a rename to a slug already taken by another project in the org (409)
rejects a slug that normalizes to empty (400)
treats a same-slug rename as a no-op (no redirect minted)
permanently deletes only when the name confirmation matches

limits: Seeded identities and sessions; no login flow
No collision-slug compound error or concurrent preference edit validation
